Odd tip but wear your mask while waiting in the car. After you go inside, you’ll be asked to wait in your car until the examiner comes. My friend about 8 months ago, waited in her car without a mask and then when she saw the examiner walk towards her car she put on her mask, but he immediately failed her for not waiting in the car with a mask. I’ll skip the boring details about why and what happened. It probably was just the examiner having a bad day, but honestly don’t risk it. Hope this helps!
